name: Tong
tagline: A quiet morning café in Mirabad: all-day breakfast and unhurried coffee

listing.description: A website for a breakfast café or bakery: warm paper tones, lots of air, a dish menu and a room album.

seo.title: Tong — all-day breakfast café in Mirabad, Tashkent
seo.description: Breakfast until 17:00: syrniki, shakshuka and sourdough toast, filter coffee and cappuccino. The café at 22 Shahrisabz St is open daily from 8 am.
seo.answer: Tong is a breakfast café at 22 Shahrisabz St in Mirabad, open daily 8:00–17:00. Breakfast is served all day: syrniki 48,000 UZS, shakshuka 56,000 UZS, cappuccino 30,000 UZS. Weekend tables are booked on Telegram.

sections.title: A morning that doesn’t rush you
sections.subtitle: Breakfast until five, filter coffee in ceramics and a big table by the window. Come and stay — nobody will ask you to leave.

sections.label: About
sections.title: “Tong” means “morning”
sections.text: We are a small café on a quiet Mirabad street: twelve tables, light walls and windows onto a yard with an elm tree. Breakfasts are made with produce from Mirabad bazaar, we bake our own sourdough, and our coffee is roasted by friends in Tashkent.
